title: DeliveryMetricsV1
description: MBR-012: the canonical delivered-content metrics. bytes, chars, tokens, and sha256 are ALL derived from one UTF-8 serialization of the exact content, so the renderer, the persistent telemetry, the delivery ledger, and the receipt digest agree byte-for-byte. bytes = UTF-8 byte count; chars = Unicode code-point count; tokens = ceil(bytes/4); sha256 = hex digest of the UTF-8 bytes.

bytes.description: UTF-8 byte count of the exact content.

chars.description: Unicode code-point count (NOT UTF-16 code units).

sha256.description: Hex digest of the UTF-8 bytes.
